colophon: Thus ends the Narasimha Raksha Mantra.

lines.1: Om, salutation to Narasimha, who tore open the chest of Hiranyakashipu,
lines.2: who pervades the three worlds, who destroys the affliction of bhutas, pretas, pishachas, and shakinis:
lines.3: all the faults born of water, strike them, strike them! Drive them off, drive them off! Move, move! Shake them, shake them!
lines.4: Crush them, crush them! Hum phat, hum phat, thah thah! The Great Rudra commands: svaha.
